source_row.rationale: Bile acid sequestrants like cholestyramine can interfere with the absorption of other oral medications, so timing separation is generally recommended to avoid reduced effectiveness of concurrent medications.
source_row.source_name: FDA Prescribing Information — Bile Acid Sequestrants
